scripts.build: npm run proto && npm run build:demo
scripts.check: npm run proto && node scripts/check-config.mjs && npm run cf-typegen -- --check && npm run typecheck && npm run test

REALTIME_SFU_APP_ID.description: The App ID of a Realtime SFU app. Create one in **Realtime > SFU** in the Cloudflare dashboard.

REALTIME_SFU_BEARER_TOKEN.description: The API token of the same SFU app.

DEVICE_PRIVATE_KEY.description: From `npm run keys`. See [Keys](https://github.com/mazupo/cf-sfu-worker/blob/main/docs/deployment/deploy.md#1-make-the-keys). Devices use the matching public key.

VIEWER_PRIVATE_KEY.description: From `npm run keys`. See [Keys](https://github.com/mazupo/cf-sfu-worker/blob/main/docs/deployment/deploy.md#1-make-the-keys). Viewers use the matching public key.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Origins of the web pages that may call the token API, separated by commas. `*` allows every page.
